verdict.rationale: Publishing per-state appointment details (agent address, designating form, who files it) is a fair axis for a registered-agent provider, so it applies. The evidence pack has no first-party content: the site returned a Cloudflare challenge at robots.txt. The only community item concerns the company's SEO visibility and says nothing about appointment details. With no evidence of the capability, the verdict is none; confidence is medium because the lack of evidence comes from the access wall rather than a documented absence.
